verdict.rationale: incident.io clearly offers hosted public/private status pages that can be automatically driven from incident state via Workflows and a Status Page API/automation (docs-22, docs-57, docs-8, docs-81, docs-9, docs-69, docs-82, docs-67), which covers the core 'incident-state-driven publishing' part of the story. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of custom domain support or subscriber notification features for status pages. missing for 10: custom domain hosting evidence, subscriber notification/email-SMS alerting evidence.
